summary_en: 320,000 shares (8.6% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 up to ¥640M ceiling. Execution window 10 Aug 2026 – 31 Oct 2026. Stated rationale: shareholder profit return and capital efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice of decision on matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Asahipen Corporation's board resolved to acquire treasury shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied via Article 165(3)). The company will purchase up to 320,000 ordinary shares (8.6% of the 3,707,481 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate limit of ¥640 million via open-market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 between 10 August and 31 October 2026. The stated purpose is to return profits to shareholders, improve capital efficiency, and maintain flexibility for future capital policies in response to changing business conditions. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 792,519 treasury shares.
